title: A push to a PR branch whose newest review round passed asks until that round's record is posted
why: Lanes lint-before-record-push (#1755, 21:30 CST) and archive-refuses-unpr-branch (#1744, about 20:57 CST) each pushed a fix before posting the round's record, so the tool could not write a fix-check record and a fresh round was needed.
note: Related: reviewed-head-push-ask (#1725) asks only when a record with a Fix check exists; this is the no-record-yet case. fix-push-needs-fail-record covers a FAIL round with no record; this covers a PASS round. Coordinator 21:31 CST Nov 7; filed 21:33 CST. Incident 3: lane auto-merge-refused (#1763) had no review record after rounds 1 and 2 (coordinator, 21:41 CST Nov 7). Incident 4: lane notes-fix-page (session_013NEJKzjkypcToggneCjJN8) pushed a notes fix on #1733 before posting its round-3 record; merge --review-record refused both heads, which cost one extra sonnet recheck. Guard candidate: the merge refusal names the order, record first, then the push (coordinator, 22:20 CST Nov 7). Incident 5 (the coordinator counted it as the third): lane coordinator-pick-needs-record pushed a notes commit to #1771 after a round-2 PASS whose comment had no record marker, so no fix-check record was possible. The round-2 record was re-posted at the new head, and a haiku fix check covered the notes diff. Lane's guard: a reviewer posts its record through `merge --review-record` before it reports PASS, and a lane push after a PASS checks that a marker-form record exists for the head it pushes from (coordinator, 22:52 CST Nov 7).
